reference.name: NEURON
reference.membrane: Native hh with usetable_hh=0, cm=1, ena=50, ek=-77, el=-54.3
reference.synapses: Native Exp2Syn + voltage-threshold NetCon; event timing independently produced by NEURON
reference.field: Independent 48-point disk quadrature; source/sink field transformed into exact node-wise axial current forcing
reference.geometry: Each physical compartment is nseg=1 native Section; zero-area branch nodes are section endpoints
reference.extracellular: Native total membrane current (fast_imem) with independently implemented endpoint-log line-source and disk averaging
reference.scope: Complete branched 2-graft/3-host numerical benchmark. Synthetic canonical-HH cells at stated temperature. No empirical biological validation.

criteria.strictPointwiseRole: Preserved additional diagnostic; reported separately from RMS/timing acceptance, never discarded or loosened after an outcome.
criteria.alignment: Compare the same physical times. No voltage offset, time shift, waveform alignment, or rescaling.

developmentDiscrepancies.stage: Native reference sample collection, first run
developmentDiscrepancies.observed: NEURON scheduled Vector.record returned 800 of 801 requested samples; accumulated h.t was within floating-point error of the 40 ms final boundary.
developmentDiscrepancies.resolution: Read the final already-computed native state directly, only when h.t and the requested endpoint agree within 1e-8 ms.
developmentDiscrepancies.impact: No model equation, numerical timestep, initial condition, voltage tolerance, waveform alignment, or synaptic timing was altered.

limitations: Agreement is with independently implemented numerical mechanisms, not measured graft recordings.
Matched-timestep agreement verifies software equivalence; separate timestep and spatial refinement tests assess convergence toward the continuous equations.
Uniform prescribed disk current in an unbounded isotropic conductor does not model polarization or insulating substrates.
Native NetCon threshold/event delivery and JS interpolation/ceil delivery may differ by a numerical step; no timing alignment is applied.
The strict 0.5 mV pointwise diagnostic is retained even when RMS and spike-timing acceptance pass.
